title: Salvage release fixes from stale PR #290 onto develop
description: PR #290 (release: promote develop to main, 2026-09-17) was never merged; later promotions (#374, #379) bypassed it. Its six fixes never reached main: d05fa793 remove duplicate console board steps; f6713bc7 right-now test avoid writing credential literals; dabe88b3 restore console active tree helpers; 80bc3691 stabilize coordination and console parity tests; 00c45ef4 initialize MQTT scenario messages; 8dd5a9f3 coverage rebaseline. Port all six onto a branch off develop, update the two that no longer apply cleanly, get tests passing, PR into develop, then close #290 referencing the new PR.
